nodes.statement: G4 reports one alignment-negative co-covered step with only the coarse reason code negative_co_covered_step, and it reports 3 timeouts as in_flight without a durable per-call elapsed-time record. The bounded problem is whether an additive, write-only provenance sidecar in a G4-derived child can assign exactly one deterministic alignment outcome and, when negative, one declared reason code to every eligible step on a provably complete trace; keep incomplete source unknown; and record a bounded derived task-elapsed estimate or explicit unknown for the last durable event of each observed timeout, without reading answers or changing agent-visible behavior or scoring.

nodes.counterexample: The negative step may be caused by post-run normalization or ordinal mapping rather than by agent behavior; a durable pre-exec record may represent a harness-blocked or killed call that no agent-side change can address; the timeouts may not recur; a task can have complete provenance and still fail strict evaluation; derived elapsed may be unknown when the runner and hook monotonic domains cannot be validated or spawn-remaining is unavailable; and the sidecar may add no explanatory value if all negative steps collapse to one coarse reason code.
nodes.falsification_condition: Contradicted if any eligible step on a provably complete trace lacks exactly one declared outcome code or is assigned more than one outcome code; any alignment-negative step lacks exactly one declared reason code; any observed timeout is assigned completed without a matching post-exec completion, in_flight without a durable pre-exec record, or conflicting statuses; a derived elapsed value is emitted when clock-domain or spawn-remaining validation fails or is nonmonotone; or the sidecar persists raw arguments, raw tool names, messages, results, task IDs, answers, hints, validator content, digest strings, raw deadline or spawn-remaining values, monotonic readings, baselines, credentials, or task content, or changes agent-visible input, dispatch, results, or scoring. A properly classified negative step falsifies alignment support but not provenance-classification support. Coverage below 0.8 in a non-timeout cohort, no covered eligible step, no covered negative step for the reason-code subclaim, no observed timeout, or unavailable elapsed derivation makes the corresponding part inconclusive or untested rather than falsified. A strict-pass difference alone neither supports nor falsifies.
nodes.prediction: In one formal 56-task no-hint run with the fixed 1200 s limit and strict all-56 scoring: (1) known-strict-fail, strict-pass, and strict-verdict-unknown cohorts each reach complete-task coverage of at least 0.8, where covered means every eligible step in the task has exactly one non-unknown outcome; coverage in [0.8,1.0) is reported as support for the covered set with uncovered tasks unknown, not as full-cohort classification; the timeout cohort is reported separately and is not predicted to meet the 0.8 coverage guard; (2) every covered negative step receives exactly one reason code from the declared deterministic set, or the reason-code subclaim is untested if no negative step occurs; (3) when at least one timeout occurs, every observed timeout receives a non-unknown last-event status with a durable pre-exec or post-exec basis, and each such timeout records a validated derived task-elapsed estimate or explicit unknown at its last durable event; timeout-elapsed is inconclusive if any is unknown, and timeout components are inconclusive or untested if no timeout occurs; (4) the strict-pass partition is reported descriptively with no predicted increase; and (5) enabling the sidecar produces no agent-visible or scoring change.
nodes.statement: In the verified G4 child, a write-only provenance sidecar at the existing DataAgentWithSelfObservation._handle_tool_call hook will make the G4 alignment contradiction and timeout state locally interpretable: every eligible step will receive exactly one deterministic alignment outcome, aligned or one of zero_match, multi_match, or category_mismatch, or exactly one declared unknown reason, with missing or incomplete source remaining unknown and a provably complete trace expected to be classifiable; every covered step will have exactly one reason code; every observed timeout will receive a last-durable-event status of completed or in_flight from matched pre/post-exec records, or unknown when no durable event exists; a bounded derived task-elapsed estimate from the fixed 1200 s limit, spawn-remaining value, and monotonic clock will be recorded at the last durable event when clock-domain validation passes, otherwise explicit unknown; and the sidecar will not change agent-visible inputs, dispatch, results, or scoring. This is a diagnostic claim about observability and classification, not task progress, correctness, alignment success, or causal gain. A task can be classification-positive and alignment-negative; that outcome is reported as a classified contradiction, not as alignment support.

nodes.implementation_scope: One hook-local sidecar in a new G4-derived child: one durable pre-exec append and one durable post-exec append per hook invocation, and an optional best-effort task-end summary. The pre-exec and post-exec records persist only a bounded derived task-elapsed estimate or explicit unknown, computed in memory from the fixed 1200 s protocol limit, DAB_TASK_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC, DAB_TASK_SPAWN_REMAINING_SEC, and a hook-local monotonic clock under the declared validation and unknown fallback. No new tool, task, prompt, policy sentence, timing limit, retry taxonomy, second arm, sham run, probe run, or extra formal evaluation. The source-field allowlist and post-exec completion boundary must be confirmed in the bound parent before implementation; if completion cannot be observed without reading tool results, messages, or task content, do not launch. Tool identity is not persisted or compared across boundaries. The experiment is diagnostic and does not attempt to repair or redesign G4.
nodes.intervention: Add one additive, write-only provenance sidecar in a new child of G4, alongside the existing G4 journal. At the existing DataAgentWithSelfObservation._handle_tool_call hook, before tool dispatch, append only an anonymous task index, hook-local step ordinal, in-memory canonical repeat/nonrepeat/unknown category computed from tool_name and parsed_tool_args, and a bounded derived task-elapsed estimate or explicit unknown computed from the fixed 1200 s limit, DAB_TASK_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC, DAB_TASK_SPAWN_REMAINING_SEC, and a hook-local monotonic clock under the declared validation. Immediately after the wrapped call returns, append a hook-local completion boolean and the same bounded derived elapsed estimate or unknown. At task end, append an optional summary containing only the same allowed fields and aggregate counts. After the run, join only post-run normalized step ordinal, normalized signal_category, and trace completeness metadata. Compute one deterministic alignment outcome and, when negative or unknown, one reason-code enum in memory from allowed fields. Do not persist raw arguments, raw tool names, messages, results, task IDs, answers, hints, validator content, digest strings, raw deadline, spawn-remaining values, monotonic readings, baselines, credentials, or task content. Do not block, retry, mutate arguments, inject messages, feed the agent, change tool dispatch, change error handling, change result storage, or change scoring. Existing G4 sidecar and all frozen artifacts remain unchanged.

measurement_plan.cohort_aggregation: Report task and step counts separately for known strict fail, strict pass, strict-verdict unknown, and timeout failure. For each cohort report covered and uncovered task counts; classification-positive, classification-negative, and classification-unknown task counts; alignment-positive, alignment-negative, and alignment-unknown step and task counts; exact negative reason-code counts; timeout last-event status counts separately as completed, in_flight, and unknown; and derived-elapsed status counts as derived or unknown. Report coverage numerator, denominator, and rate, and report provenance-classification, alignment, timeout-status, timeout-elapsed, and reason-code subclaim statuses separately. Never pool cohorts to mask missing coverage; the strict-pass partition is descriptive and no correctness or causal contrast is inferred.
measurement_plan.contradicted_conditions: Contradicted, with precedence over supported and inconclusive, if any eligible step on a provably complete trace lacks exactly one declared outcome code or is assigned more than one outcome code; any alignment-negative step lacks exactly one declared reason code; any observed timeout is assigned completed without a matching post-exec completion or in_flight without a durable pre-exec record, or has conflicting statuses; a derived elapsed value is emitted when clock-domain or spawn-remaining validation fails or is nonmonotone; or the sidecar persists raw arguments, raw tool names, messages, results, task IDs, answers, hints, validator content, digest strings, raw deadline or spawn-remaining values, monotonic readings, baselines, credentials, or task content, or changes agent-visible input, dispatch, results, or scoring. A properly classified alignment-negative step is a contradiction of alignment support but not of provenance-classification support; it is reported under alignment-contradicted, not as an unclassifiable outcome. Absent a contradiction above, coverage below 0.8 is inconclusive rather than contradicted.
measurement_plan.coverage_denominator: The overall denominator is the fixed 56 tasks. After the frozen evaluator runs, each cohort denominator is the observed number of tasks in known strict fail, strict pass, strict-verdict unknown, or timeout failure; G4 reference counts are 16, 34, 3, and 3 but are not reused as denominators. A task is covered when it has at least one eligible step and every eligible step has exactly one non-unknown alignment outcome, positive or negative; reason-code validity and timeout-status validity are checked separately and do not change coverage. Complete-task coverage for a cohort is the number of covered tasks divided by that cohort's observed denominator. Report numerator, denominator, and rate separately. Coverage in [0.8,1.0) means support applies to the covered task set only and uncovered tasks remain classification-unknown; it does not mean every task in the cohort was classified.
measurement_plan.inconclusive_conditions: With no contradiction above, provenance-classification is inconclusive for a cohort if complete-task coverage is below 0.8, no covered task has an eligible step, or a required status cannot be evaluated; coverage in [0.8,1.0) is not by itself inconclusive. Alignment is inconclusive if it is neither contradicted nor supported, including coverage below 0.8 or no covered eligible step. The reason-code subclaim is untested in a cohort with no covered negative step. The timeout-status component is inconclusive or untested if no timeout occurs, any observed timeout has no durable pre/post event, or last-event pairing is ambiguous. The timeout-elapsed component is inconclusive if no timeout occurs or any observed timeout lacks a validated derived elapsed value. A stochastic strict-pass difference alone is inconclusive.
measurement_plan.inertness_check: Before launch, static data-flow review and hook-local enabled-versus-disabled tests must show identical control flow, return values, messages, dispatch, results, and scoring. In the formal run the sidecar is write-only and no sidecar output is read by the agent. Any agent-visible read or behavioral change invalidates the instrument and the experiment.
measurement_plan.no_answer_no_hint_boundary: The sidecar may read only the source-field allowlist. It may read tool_name and parsed_tool_args in memory solely to compute the canonical repeat/nonrepeat/unknown category and must immediately discard them. It may read hook-local ordinal and completion state, the hook-local monotonic clock, DAB_TASK_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC, DAB_TASK_SPAWN_REMAINING_SEC, and the fixed 1200 s protocol limit solely to derive a bounded task-elapsed estimate or unknown; it must not persist raw deadline, spawn-remaining values, monotonic readings, or baselines. After the run it may read only frozen post-run structural fields and completeness metadata. It must not persist, log, expose, or otherwise use benchmark answers, hints, validators, expected outputs, task IDs, raw traces, messages, tool results, raw argument payloads, raw tool names, credentials, network content, digest strings, or task content. Task-specific obligations are not allowed; all rules are uniform algorithms over normal task-visible inputs. Cohort labels and strict verdicts are joined only after the run and are never read by the agent or sidecar.
measurement_plan.per_step_negative_rule: On a provably complete trace with exactly one live pre-exec record and one completed post-exec record at a valid hook-local ordinal, a step is alignment-negative when the candidate normalized structural steps at that ordinal number zero (zero_match), more than one (multi_match), or exactly one whose canonical category disagrees (category_mismatch). These cases are mutually exclusive, and exactly one reason code is assigned. If an unknown precondition applies first, the step is unknown, never negative. Missing or incomplete source remains unknown and is never a false zero_match negative.
measurement_plan.per_step_positive_rule: A step is alignment-positive only when it is classification-positive and its unique normalized candidate at the hook-local ordinal agrees on canonical category; its reason_code is aligned. A step is classification-positive when trace completeness is proven, there is exactly one live pre-exec record and one completed post-exec record at a valid hook-local ordinal, and the candidate set yields exactly one of the four declared outcomes: aligned, zero_match, multi_match, or category_mismatch. Zero_match, multi_match, and category_mismatch are classification-positive but alignment-negative. Classification success is not alignment success.
measurement_plan.per_step_unknown_rule: A step is unknown when completeness metadata does not prove the trace complete; a required pre-exec or post-exec record is missing or non-unique; parsing or canonicalization fails; the call is in flight at timeout; or the ordinal relation is ambiguous. It receives exactly one unknown code, with the first applicable code in the order not_complete, missing_pre, missing_post, parse_failure, ordinal_ambiguous being the only unknown code; only when none applies are zero_match, multi_match, category_mismatch, or aligned considered, in that order. It is excluded from coverage numerators and concordance. Missing or incomplete source remains unknown, never a false zero_match negative.
measurement_plan.per_task_negative_rule: A task is classification-negative if any eligible step on a provably complete trace lacks exactly one declared outcome code or is assigned more than one outcome code; any alignment-negative step lacks exactly one declared reason code; any observed timeout is assigned a status without a durable matching pre/post basis or has conflicting statuses; a derived elapsed value is emitted when validation fails or is nonmonotone; or the sidecar changes behavior or persists prohibited content. Classification-negative takes precedence over classification-unknown. Separately, a task with a properly classified negative step is classification-positive but alignment-negative; that is a classified alignment contradiction, not a provenance-classification failure.
measurement_plan.per_task_positive_rule: A task is classification-positive only if it is not classification-negative, has at least one eligible reviewed-hook step, and every eligible step has exactly one non-unknown alignment outcome and exactly one reason code. For an observed timeout it also has exactly one durable last-event status in {completed,in_flight}; a non-timeout task does not need a timeout status. Classification-positive does not mean alignment-positive: if any outcome is negative, the task is alignment-negative and is a classified contradiction, and only a task whose every outcome is aligned is alignment-positive. It is never strict success.
measurement_plan.per_task_unknown_rule: A task is classification-unknown if it is not classification-negative and either has no eligible steps, any eligible step is unknown, or an observed timeout has no durable pre-exec or post-exec event or an ambiguous last-event status. Unknown is never imputed as positive, negative, repeat, or nonrepeat. A non-timeout task does not need a timeout status. If a task has a properly classified negative step and another unknown eligible step, it is classification-unknown; the negative step is reported but excluded from covered alignment aggregates because the task is not in the coverage numerator.
measurement_plan.run_before: All rules, enums, cohort labels, coverage denominator, coverage threshold, elapsed derivation, epsilon, and unknown fallback are fixed before child implementation or formal execution; no post-run strict verdict, task ID, answer, hint, or validator defines a rule.
measurement_plan.runtime_hook: DataAgentWithSelfObservation._handle_tool_call in the G4 code parent: pre-exec observation before tool dispatch, post-exec completion observation immediately after the wrapped call returns, and an optional best-effort task-end summary. At pre-exec, let T be the fixed 1200 s protocol limit, D be DAB_TASK_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC, N be the hook-local monotonic clock reading, and S be DAB_TASK_SPAWN_REMAINING_SEC. Validate D and N are finite, S is in [0,T], and D-N is in [-epsilon,T+epsilon] for a predeclared epsilon of 0.1 s, which checks a compatible monotonic domain and spawn-remaining consistency. Derive elapsed as clamp(T-(D-N),0,T), accept it only when baseline T-S satisfies baseline-epsilon <= elapsed <= T+epsilon and accepted elapsed is nondecreasing within the task, and otherwise emit unknown. Persist only the derived elapsed or unknown, never D, S, N, or baseline. Timeout classification uses the last durable pre-exec or post-exec event and does not require the summary. The observation is write-only and is never read by the agent.
measurement_plan.supported_conditions: For each non-timeout cohort, provenance-classification is supported for the covered task set if complete-task coverage is at least 0.8, at least one covered task has an eligible step, no covered task is classification-negative, and every eligible step in the tasks counted in the coverage numerator has exactly one non-unknown alignment outcome with exactly one reason code; coverage in [0.8,1.0) is supported for that covered set with the uncovered fraction reported as classification-unknown, and 'every' never ranges over uncovered tasks. Alignment status is reported separately: alignment-contradicted if any covered task is alignment-negative, which takes precedence over coverage; otherwise alignment-supported if provenance-classification is supported and no covered task is alignment-negative; otherwise alignment-inconclusive. The reason-code subclaim is supported only under alignment-contradicted when every covered negative step has exactly one declared reason code, and is untested when there is no covered negative step. The timeout-status component is supported only if at least one timeout is observed and every observed timeout has exactly one durable last-event status in {completed,in_flight} with a matching pre/post basis. The timeout-elapsed component is supported only if timeout-status is supported and every observed timeout has a validated derived task-elapsed value at its last durable event; an unavailable derivation leaves elapsed unknown and that component inconclusive. No sidecar-induced change is required.

limits: Structural provenance does not establish task correctness or causal gain.
Timeouts are failures in the fixed 56 denominator; unavailable records remain unknown.
Two completed strict verdicts remain unknown and are not reclassified.
This is one unpaired run; score differences from earlier generations are descriptive only.
nodes.statement: G5 provenance reason-code and timeout elapsed diagnostics on the frozen no-hint 56.
